title: ProofFlow walkthrough
format: Edited screenshots of actual application states with narration; not an uninterrupted live recording

scenes.title: Saved work can outlive its inputs.
scenes.narration: Reports can look finished after their inputs change. ProofFlow helps analytics agents keep saved work current. These briefs reuse earlier calculations. Every tool records the input versions it actually consumed. Hydra D B connects those execution receipts across runs.

scenes.title: A correction makes dependent claims stale.
scenes.narration: Correct the euro-to-dollar rate from one point one zero to one point two zero. The revenue claims become stale. ProofFlow withholds current values and labels the previous numbers as historical.

scenes.title: The path is queried from HydraDB.
scenes.narration: Open the evidence. Hydra D B shows the dependency path from that correction to this calculation and both reports.

scenes.title: Four tools. Two updated reports. Preserved support.
scenes.narration: Refresh affected work. Four tools run. E U revenue becomes two thousand two hundred eighty dollars; company revenue becomes five thousand seven hundred fifty-five. The independent support result stays unchanged.

scenes.title: Measured against fair retrieval baselines.
scenes.narration: Our frozen pilot has twelve authored scenarios, identical evidence, and a two-thousand-forty-eight-token limit. ProofFlow refreshed sixteen of twenty-nine affected reports; B M twenty-five refreshed six, dense retrieval one, and iterative hybrid nine. Every method shares the same Hydra-assisted executor. Exact dependency traversal ties ProofFlow. Full context completes all twenty-nine.

scenes.title: A model chose the workflow. Tools calculated the values.
scenes.narration: Separately, two actual Fable five point two calls chose a seven-tool report workflow, then created a new brief reusing three earlier artifacts. All seventeen composition-and-refresh checks passed. This is recorded local model execution, separate from the guided browser demo.

scenes.title: Bring your own CSV through the CLI.
scenes.narration: You can also import your own bounded C S V through the command line and reuse this same calculation runtime.

scenes.title: ProofFlow — current evidence for analytics agents.
scenes.narration: ProofFlow: follow what changed, refresh what depends on it, and preserve work that remains valid.
